column3: With respect to the Leighton District Mortgage Loan (3.7%), sponsor, Christopher L. Erickson, owns unimproved property adjacent to mortgaged property that would foreseeably compete with the Mortgaged Property (proposed 150-unit multifamily project). The Mortgage Loan documents include certain anti-poaching provisions for any sponsor-owned property within a three mile radius of the mortgaged property.
